title: vtc-server: per-viewer livestream playbackEndpoints
description: From audit JMAP-t8ej.3 (row 10), spec 035a9a0. playbackEndpoints (url, credential, expiresAt) are computed per requesting user; server MAY return [] to unauthorized users and MAY let non-participants /get a hosted livestream. Today handle_vtc_livestream_get (media.rs:137-190) only blanks streamKey/streamUri. Add a VtcBackend hook (e.g. playback_endpoints_for(caller, livestream)) called per hosted livestream in /get; default returns the stored list (spec-method-defaults: defaulting is OK, result is merely per-caller). Add an access hook for non-participant viewers of hosted livestreams (fail-closed default: participants only). Test that two callers receive different endpoints. Needs the vtc-types bead first. Additive: CHANGELOG ### Added; public-api snapshot.
